name: @pipeworx/mcp-perm

tools.name: perm_employer_certifications
tools.description: Check whether a US employer sponsors green cards (PERM labor certification) and profile their sponsorship, from DOL PERM (Form ETA-9089) disclosures. Answers 'does company X sponsor green cards' for recruiting and candidate advising. Returns the number of certified PERM filings, offered-wage range (min / median / max), the top sponsored job titles, and top worksite locations for the employer. Filter by year (DOL federal fiscal year, Oct-Sep); defaults to the latest full year. Employer name is matched as the disclosed legal name (e.g. 'Microsoft Corporation', 'Amazon.com Services LLC').

employer.description: Employer name to look up, e.g. "Microsoft", "Oracle", "Amazon".

year.description: Filing year (e.g. 2025). Defaults to the most recent full year this pack has data for. Interpreted as DOL federal fiscal year (Oct-Sep).

tools.name: perm_salary
tools.description: Look up real green-card (PERM) offered wages for a job title from DOL PERM disclosures — a market wage benchmark backed by actual certified filings (not estimates). Answers 'what do green-card-sponsored software engineers earn at company X / in city Y'. Filter by job title, and optionally by employer, city, and year. Returns wage statistics (count, min / median / average / max) plus a sample of individual records (employer, title, wage, location, dates).

job_title.description: Job title to search, e.g. "software engineer", "data scientist". Matched as a substring of the disclosed title.

employer.description: Optional employer name to scope to, e.g. "Meta".

year.description: Filing year (e.g. 2025). Defaults to the most recent full year.

limit.description: Max sample records to return (default 15, max 50).

tools.name: perm_top_sponsors
tools.description: Find which US employers sponsor the most green cards (PERM labor certifications) for a given job title (optionally in a specific city) — a candidate-sourcing / target-account signal for recruiting. Answers 'which companies sponsor the most data engineers for green cards' or 'top PERM sponsors for nurses'. Returns employers ranked by certified PERM filings for the role, each with their filing count and median offered wage. Backed by real DOL PERM disclosures.

job_title.description: Job title to rank sponsors for, e.g. "data engineer", "physical therapist".

city.description: Optional worksite city to scope to, e.g. "AUSTIN" or "NEW YORK".

year.description: Filing year (e.g. 2025). Defaults to the most recent full year.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-perm forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the perm pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
